Cloud connection

Customers and shop data sync automatically after sign-in. Other open devices check for updates every 5 seconds. Conflicts pause uploads and preserve your local work.

Sync tools, backups & recovery

On a conflict: export both copies, choose “Resolve: use cloud copy,” then reapply your intended edits or import a reviewed combined JSON backup. The app never silently merges or overwrites conflicting saved changes. Initial migration needs confirmation; starting with samples does not upload until you save a change or import a backup.

V7: customer profiles and shop data sync with your account. Customer-to-order linking is still a later step. Use V7 on every device after switching. Export a cloud backup before importing any test data.

Backup & restore

Export a JSON backup containing customers and shop data. Import replaces the entire saved shop, including customers, and queues automatic cloud sync after confirmation. Export a cloud backup first. Older backups have no customer profiles; importing them clears the Customers list.
